thresholds.R1: |z| <= 3 on headline events (~2% family-wise false fail for 7 events under a calibrated simulator)
thresholds.R2: W1 <= 95th pct of split-half real-vs-real W1 at the same sample size (measured, not chosen)
thresholds.R3: point-estimate 1X2 LL beats the league prior (same bar as the publishable gate; reported, not required for window_pass)

pred.assumption: Poisson thinning of predictive lambdas (world-averaged; no match-state model)

red_cards.note: static generator cannot condition on red cards — the gap between these means is the size of the unmodelled effect

neutral_venue.note: home advantage is applied uniformly; neutral rows are rare in club data but this quantifies the exposure
